events.title: Argentina's largest investment project aims to export Vaca Muerta gas
events.description: Argentina's majority state-owned oil company YPF confirmed that it has filed an application for the Argentina LNG project to join the Large Investment Incentive Regime (RIGI).

events.title: Fireworks light skies over Pakistan’s capital as crowds celebrate Independence Day
events.description: Fireworks lit up Pakistan’s capital as crowds celebrated the 79th anniversary of independence.

events.title: Romania shuts nuclear plant, Hungary dams dry Danube River
events.description: Romania has shut down its only nuclear plant in a rare move prompted by the lack of cooling water from the Danube River

events.title: Saudi crown prince, CENTCOM chief discuss regional tensions
events.description: Saudi Crown Prince Mohammed bin Salman held talks with US Central Command chief Adm. Brad Cooper on Thursday, focusing on efforts to ease regional tensions and strengthen defense.

events.title: US sells 30-year bonds at highest borrowing costs since 2001
events.description: Yields have jumped amid concerns over mounting public debt and persistently high inflation

events.title: Russia's 'Amazon' in deep-strike Ukraine blitz, wiping billions from Putin-linked CEO
events.description: Ukraine's drone strikes have knocked out 27% of Wildberries warehouse capacity, with losses estimated up to $8.5 billion as Russia's logistics reels.

events.title: Vote counting underway in Zambia after presidential election
events.description: Vote counting is underway after Zambians cast ballots in a presidential election testing incumbent Hakainde Hichilema’s economic record.

events.title: Israel kills Gaza police chief
events.description: Israel has killed the police chief of Gaza in an attack on Gaza City, the interior ministry of the Gaza Strip announced

events.title: Colombia’s new president asks Trump to bring militarized antidrug campaign to the country
events.description: The South American nation is the world’s largest producer of cocaine

events.title: Authorities in Vietnam discover more than a ton of concealed ivory illegally shipped from Africa
events.description: Vietnamese authorities have seized a large shipment of ivory illegally shipped from Africa

events.title: Tehran says Strait of Hormuz 'under Iran's control' after Trump threat
events.description: Tehran has asserted that the Strait of Hormuz is 'under Iran's control and management' after President Trump said the U.S. might 'keep it'

events.title: Poland arrests Russian allegedly hired to kill Ukrainian-American
events.description: Polish Prime Minister Donald Tusk says Poland arrested a Russian citizen recruited by Russian intelligence to kill a Ukrainian-American in Warsaw.

events.title: Yemen at highest risk of major conflict since 2022 truce, UN warns
events.description: Yemen faces its most serious threat of a return to large-scale war since a U.N.-brokered truce in 2022, U.N. envoy Hans Grundberg warned.

events.title: Complete withdrawal of U.S. troops from Iraq by Sept. 30th
events.description: The United States will complete a full withdrawal of all troops from Iraq by September 30th, Iraq's Prime Minister Ali al-Zaidi announced following a meeting with U.S. Central Command (CENTCOM) commander.

events.title: Nero's Bridge emerges from Tiber River as Rome faces water crisis
events.description: Rome's ancient Nero's Bridge has reemerged from the Tiber River as exceptionally low water levels expose parts of the historic structure.

events.title: DRC's fast-growing Ebola outbreak spreads to sixth province
events.description: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has spread to a sixth province.

events.title: Mali frees 82 soldiers held by militants, pardons French embassy official
events.description: Mali says 82 soldiers held captive since deadly attacks in April have been freed by armed groups, in a rare breakthrough as the country battles jihadist and rebel insurgencies.

events.title: China and Indonesia’s joint naval drills anger Taiwan
events.description: Chinese state media have released footage of a joint naval drill with Indonesia in waters east of Taiwan.

events.title: Explosion Strikes Ammunition Plant Near Rome
events.description: An explosion occurred at an ammunition manufacturing plant near Rome, with no injuries reported.

events.title: Displaced families and hospitals struggle as Sudan's war ravages El-Obeid
events.description: The war, which began in April 2023, has killed at least 59,000 people, displaced around 13 million, and pushed large parts of Sudan into famine.

events.title: Turkey set to sign charter for Saudi-led Red Sea coalition on Friday
events.description: Ankara pledged support for the proposed multinational alliance last month, but Friday’s expected signing will mark its formal entry into the Saudi-led grouping.

events.title: Zambian president Hichilema votes as he seeks second term
events.description: Zambian president Hakainde Hichilema cast his vote in the capital Lusaka as he bids for a second term.

events.title: Iran war depletes US Reaper drone arsenal
events.description: The US military has lost roughly 25% of its Reaper drones as the Iran war depletes its arsenal, with the aircraft seeing heavy use around the Strait of Hormuz.

events.title: IDF strikes Hamas terror cell, resuming preemptive strikes despite Trump's Gaza deal
events.description: After curbing its operations in line with US instructions since the July deal took effect, the IDF is confident on removing ongoing threats in Gaza, military sources said.

events.title: U.S. Sending Fresh Aircraft Carrier to Middle East Amid Iran War Strain
events.description: The U.S. is sending a fresh aircraft carrier to the Middle East amid the Iran war strain.

events.title: Gaza's beekeepers rebuild livelihoods amid war ruins
events.description: Beekeepers in Gaza are rebuilding their livelihoods, handling swarms and collecting honey from colonies that survived the war.

events.title: DRC’s fast-growing Ebola outbreak spreads to sixth province
events.description: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has spread to a sixth province, with a man dying in Bas-Uele after travelling from Haut-Uele
events.location: Bas-Uele, Democratic Republic of the Congo

events.title: Ukraine's monthly civilian casualties highest since 2022
events.description: UN monitors say civilian casualties in Ukraine hit their highest monthly level since the start of Russia's full-scale war.

events.title: Congo’s Fastest-Growing Ebola Outbreak Reaches A New Province
events.description: A death has been recorded in Bas-Uele, bringing the number of Congo’s affected provinces to six.
events.location: Bas-Uele, Democratic Republic of the Congo

events.title: Bill Gates in S. Korea to discuss cooperation in next-generation nuclear reactors
events.description: American billionaire and founder of TerraPower Bill Gates is in Seoul to discuss cooperation in next-generation nuclear reactors

events.title: Iran's state media mock Trump over airplane switch
events.description: Iran's state media mock Trump over airplane switch, meme shows him hiding in a catering truck
